en_title: Nvidia RTX 5090 Reportedly Dead, but It's So Expensive That It Doesn't Really Matter
cn_title: RTX 5090据称停产，已贵到无所谓
subtitle: 买不起的旗舰
opus_summary: 爆料称英伟达将停止向RTX 5090供应芯片，后续供应专供RTX Pro。英伟达尚未回应，作者认为可能只是供货减少；若真停产，主要受影响的将是游戏整机。

paragraphs.en: While the RTX 5090 was already hard enough to get at a reasonable price, new leaks suggest that Nvidia is flat-out discontinuing its flagship graphics card.
paragraphs.cn: 想以合理价格买到RTX 5090，本来就已经够难了。而最新爆料显示，英伟达可能要直接停产这款旗舰显卡。

paragraphs.en: GPU leaker zed__wang on X/Twitter posted about the RTX 5090, saying there would be "no more GB202 for 5090, confirmed." They then followed up with a quote tweet, saying, "All future GB202 supplies are RTX Pro exclusive."
paragraphs.cn: 显卡爆料者zed__wang在X上发帖谈及RTX 5090，称「已确认，不会再为5090供应GB202」。随后，zed__wang又引用该帖补充道：「今后所有GB202都将专供RTX Pro。」

paragraphs.en: For the uninitiated, GB202 is the name of the actual GPU die that powers the RTX 5090, and it has always powered more than just the RTX 5090. Instead, the GB202 powers nine distinct workstation and data center GPUs, according to TechPowerUp . It shouldn't be too surprising, then, that Nvidia would opt to prioritize much more expensive graphics cards like the Nvidia RTX Pro 6000 Blackwell, which costs around $18,000, rather than the RTX 5090, which costs around $9,000 on Newegg these days.
paragraphs.cn: 不了解的读者可能需要先认识一下GB202：这是RTX 5090所用GPU芯片的名称，而且它从来就不只用于RTX 5090。据TechPowerUp统计，九款不同的工作站和数据中心GPU都采用了GB202。因此，英伟达如果选择优先供应贵得多的显卡，而不是RTX 5090，也不该太让人意外。例如，英伟达RTX Pro 6000 Blackwell的售价约为18,000美元(约合人民币12万元)，而RTX 5090如今在Newegg上的售价约为9,000美元(约合人民币6万元)。

paragraphs.en: Nvidia also hasn't been shy about prioritizing AI over the gaming division, with the company dropping gaming from its earnings report , and working it into the 'Edge Computing' category.
paragraphs.cn: 英伟达也毫不掩饰AI业务比游戏业务更优先的立场：公司已不再在财报中单列游戏业务，而是将其并入「边缘计算」类别。

paragraphs.en: While the leak suggests that the discontinuation of the RTX 5090 is confirmed, it is anything but. Nvidia hasn't commented on its flagship card going away. That doesn't mean much on the surface, but if you look back to February, similar rumors were spinning up about the RTX 5070 Ti , and no matter how convincing those leaks were, they ended up being completely false.
paragraphs.cn: 虽然爆料声称RTX 5090停产已获确认，但事实远非如此。英伟达尚未就这款旗舰显卡退出市场发表评论。单看这一点，说明不了什么，但回顾2月，RTX 5070 Ti也曾传出类似传闻。那些爆料无论当时多么令人信服，最终都被证明完全不属实。

paragraphs.en: I've asked Nvidia for comment and will update this article if I hear back, but I suspect that this RTX 5090 situation is very similar. Back then, production on the RTX 5070 Ti stalled as VRAM was being prioritized for data centers, but the RTX 5070 Ti itself didn't get discontinued. It's probably going to be a similar story for the RTX 5090, with new units slowing to a trickle as prices continue to rise.
paragraphs.cn: 我已向英伟达寻求回应，收到回复后会更新本文，但我怀疑RTX 5090这次的情况非常相似。当时，由于显存优先供应数据中心，RTX 5070 Ti的生产陷入停滞，但这款显卡本身并未停产。RTX 5090可能也会经历类似情况：新卡供应越来越少，价格则继续上涨。

paragraphs.en: Either way, for most people, the RTX 5090 has been effectively discontinued for months, if not this entire year. It seems like a distant memory at this point, but the RTX 5090 launched in January 2025 for $1,999 , but that price has skyrocketed since. Now that graphics card's price is inching closer to the $10,000 mark, and while there are definitely people who can afford to invest that kind of money into their computer, for most DIY PC gamers, the RTX 5090 might as well not even exist.
paragraphs.cn: 无论如何，对大多数人来说，RTX 5090即便不是一整年，也已经有好几个月与停产无异了。RTX 5090于2025年1月上市时，售价为1,999美元(约合人民币1万元)，如今这似乎已是遥远的记忆，因为此后价格一路飙升。现在，这款显卡的售价正逐渐逼近10,000美元(约合人民币7万元)。确实有人负担得起，愿意在电脑上投入这么多钱，但对大多数自己装机的PC玩家而言，RTX 5090简直就跟不存在一样。

paragraphs.en: If the RTX 5090 was discontinued, it would mostly impact prebuilt gaming PCs. After all, prebuilts strapped with that graphics haven't seen the same astronomical jump in price quite yet, and you can get a decent Alienware tower with a 5090 for less than it costs to just buy the GPU on Newegg right now. But, if Nvidia were to stop manufacturing the RTX 5090, that would likely stop immediately.
paragraphs.cn: 如果RTX 5090停产，主要受影响的将是游戏整机。毕竟，搭载这款显卡的整机还没有出现同样夸张的价格涨幅。目前，买一台配置不错、搭载5090的Alienware塔式主机，花费比在Newegg上单买这块显卡还少。但如果英伟达停止生产RTX 5090，这种情况很可能会立即终结。

paragraphs.en: It's not clear what's going to happen with the RTX 5090, but regardless, it's hard to imagine any world where the high-end GPU doesn't continue to go up in price as RAMageddon continues. And now that it's rumored that Nvidia won't launch its next-generation graphics cards until 2028 , it could be a long time before any high-end GPU is a reasonable price — if it ever even happens again.
paragraphs.cn: RTX 5090接下来会怎样，目前还不清楚。但无论如何，随着这场内存危机（RAMageddon）持续，很难想象这款高端GPU的价格会不再上涨。如今又有传闻称，英伟达要到2028年才会推出下一代显卡。因此，可能还要等很久，才能有高端GPU回到合理价位——前提是这样的价位还会再出现。
